<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **24** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5eeb02c614f3aa297c17c2048b112f4b605543fd` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2d82a9a1e996be9e75c2afe24c289adbcf1d4f3d` — the merge of head `80aab79ea2ace233d29d48c7c5d59c4c6088fa8d` into base `5eeb02c614f3aa297c17c2048b112f4b605543fd`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2d82a9a1e996be9e75c2afe24c289adbcf1d4f3d && git checkout 2d82a9a1e996be9e75c2afe24c289adbcf1d4f3d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5eeb02c614f3aa297c17c2048b112f4b605543fd 80aab79ea2ace233d29d48c7c5d59c4c6088fa8d && git checkout -B drift-repro 5eeb02c614f3aa297c17c2048b112f4b605543fd && git merge --no-ff 80aab79ea2ace233d29d48c7c5d59c4c6088fa8d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5eeb02c614f3aa297c17c2048b112f4b605543fd
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5eeb02c614f3aa297c17c2048b112f4b605543fd` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

- **The submit door, read on the diff:** only declared fields that carry a value are judged; a value in a field whose declared type is in `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` is refused before the write, naming the field, as `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[]` code `invalid_value` (ADR-0114), in one envelope with the `required` judgement. Empty or absent file fields submit as before. No error code is added.
- **The claim path, read on the diff:** both `sys_file` lookups (`applyCopyOnClaim`, `claimFile`) now carry the acting organization as `tenantId` through `systemReadContext`, the channel `systemWriteContext` already opens for the copy, so the driver's tenant term decides; no hand-written organization comparison. An id outside that reach is kept as written, as an unmanaged id is. A write with no organization, and the `single` posture, read as before. Accepted edge: under a walled posture a referenced file with no organization stamp may no longer be claimed; the full dogfood battery's upload flows held.
- **Overlap with PR #25641** (`form-routes.ts`): disjoint hunks; `git merge-tree` with its head `08b020c9d3` exits 0 with no conflicted path. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
- **One existing pin changed with its subject kept:** `public-form-intake-availability.test.ts` now asserts `['view', 'object']` (one object read, by the field judgement).
- **CI on head `80aab79ea2`:** 34 success, 7 skipped, 0 red; every skip on main's roster. **Dogfood battery** (owed by the arm), pinned to `80aab79ea2`: `os-verify-lock` `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 294 passed | 3 skipped, Tests 2516 passed | 18 skipped, no failure.
- **Disclosure:** the PR body, the changeset and the report state the rule only. Every further finding of the measurement went to the maintainer off GitHub.
- **Writes:** `mcp_calls` 0; 2 relay writes (`pr_create`, the report comment), both read back identical.

**Not landed in this act.** The `(narrowing)` arm owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue. This seat cannot start that tier (HTTP 429 usage limit), and the maintainer's word in this seat's session is 「你没有fable，可以让总监复审」: the review goes to the director seat. `needs:contract-review` is hung on this PR in this act; the PR stays draft and outside the queue until a same-form `## Contract review` PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is on its current head. Then: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` by this seat.
